title: What Does BP AI Mean? Real Answers for Adults Over 35
description: BP AI isn’t a medical term—it’s shorthand for AI tools that estimate blood pressure. 1 in 3 US adults over 35 has hypertension—learn what’s reliable and when to see a doctor.
reasoning: Users are confused by the sudden appearance of 'BP AI' in health articles and apps—especially after viral claims about phone-camera BP readings. They’re not seeking tech specs; they want clarity on whether these tools are safe, accurate, or worth trusting for their age group (35+), amid rising anxiety about undiagnosed hypertension.
